brief.zh: 横向 4:3 写实参考照片：一位虚构成年棕发女性穿蓝色碎花白裙，在阿尔卑斯湖畔露天咖啡桌前单手托腮；右侧一只蓬松的灰白猫。桌上有一杯咖啡和复古相机；背景为湖泊、帆船、小镇、山峰与花盆。
brief.en: Landscape 4:3 photographic benchmark: a fictional adult brown-haired woman in a white-and-blue floral dress rests her chin on her hand at a lakeside café table beside a fluffy gray-and-white cat. Coffee cup and vintage camera in front, alpine lake, town, boats, mountains and flowering planters behind.
